reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Full-body soreness two days out from a hard session is normal, usually called DOMS, and it tends to peak around 24 to 72 hours after training. Don't chase it, and don't use it as a reason to skip. Today we keep things easy: some light movement, good food, and enough sleep. If you tell me how many days a week you train and how long your sessions run, I'll set up your next program around that.", "patch": {}}
